comparison.objective: Open a sterile pouch and transfer forceps to a sterile drape without contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual peel, controlled gravity release, waste sorting, and strict contact avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Pouch peeled, forceps on drape, sheets discarded, arms returned, with no prohibited contact at any time.
comparison.reason: Bimanual separation and object containment are generic similarities; the central ability is sterile transfer, not contact-loaded fracture and fragment retrieval.
